params.name: rows

default.label: Largest upload (MB)
default.note: Refused at the door, not after the file is written. About 20 MB per minute of 1080p screen recording.

default.label: Storage each account may hold (GB)
default.note: 0 = no limit. Counts the recording, the narrated copy and the subtitles together; upload and Generate both check it first.

default.label: Delete recordings after (days)
default.note: 0 = keep every recording for ever. The narrated MP4, the subtitles and the script always stay - what goes is the raw upload, which is the biggest file in the folder. To change the script after that, upload the recording again.

params.label: key = the setting it saves; label and note = the words by the box; unit = what the number counts; person = may also be set for one person

description_nl: Admin -> Storage shows these boxes under 'Default for everyone'; the ones marked person also appear in one person's Edit limits. The numbers are chip portal.defaults and the owner's saved settings; what 0 means is chip portal.storage_limits.
